content: Xbox Accessibility Guideline 117: avoid camera shake/bobbing/motion blur or provide a disable option. Camera bob + FOV changes are top motion-sickness triggers (vestibular mismatch). Industry practice: intensity sliders (Halo Infinite screen shake/blur 0-100%, Cyberpunk additive camera motion, ESO head-bob slider). Ship camera sway/FOV kick with a single 'camera motion' toggle/scale, default subtle.
